paper: Alpha-GPT: Human-AI Interactive Alpha Mining for Quantitative Investment
headline_agent: human-AI interactive idea generation, formula construction, genetic-program search, alpha validation, and portfolio evaluation
component_selection_reason: The complete generated alpha set and search pipeline are unavailable. Flow of Funds is printed first but is not executable because div and cwise_mul have invalid arity. Volume-price correlation is the first source-ordered arity-valid example, appears in every Alpha-GPT version, and executes under the audit's declared conventional operator semantics without selection on JKP outcomes.
source_direction: literal positive formula orientation; no source-specific sign flip is claimed

monthly_adapter.bar_mapping: One source bar becomes one JKP month; the 20-bar rolling correlation becomes 20 months.
monthly_adapter.inputs: Absolute JKP formation-month prc supplies close and JKP tvol supplies volume.
monthly_adapter.operators: Rolling Pearson correlation with 20 complete paired observations, followed by same-month population-standard-deviation z-scoring within the common universe, matching the audit's conventional stub.
monthly_adapter.universe: Fixed formation-date largest 1,000 U.S. equities from the common JKP contract.
monthly_adapter.portfolio: Researcher-supplied common value-weighted long/short deciles from the literal formula score.
monthly_adapter.costs: Common 0/5/10/25/50 bp one-way cases with 10 bp primary.
monthly_adapter.missing_returns: Fixed holdings re-accounted under zero and adverse-100 policies without reranking or reweighting.

adapted: source universe to common U.S. top-1,000
common value-weighted deciles, costs, missingness, and JKP133 attribution
